title: Kumbakkarai Thangaiah
desc: Mangamma, who is in love with Thangaiya, is distraught while he faces a tough predicament owing to a disagreement in their village.

title: Sri Bannari Amman
desc: Goddess Bannari Amman takes the form of a skilled healer, travelling through small villages to cure people's ailments. On her divine mission, she vanquishes evil and blesses the righteous.

title: Vaimaye Vellum
desc: Raja, a rickshaw driver, shares a complicated relationship with his father. Things take a turn when a journalist investigating an ongoing crime hires him to protect his daughter.

title: Thayumanavan
desc: A police officer invites three prisoners to his house for Diwali. As they celebrate, the prisoners tell him why they hate women.

title: Mundravathu Kann
desc: A young woman trapped in her home accidentally records a horrific crime next door, triggering a dangerous game of cat and mouse as the killer tries to silence her.
